# Provider slots

Plugins declare `providers[]` with a `slot` the host knows or a namespaced plugin-defined slot. Selection, probe, fallback, and restore-defaults stay host-owned; vendor transport lives in the plugin.

Source of truth: Go catalogs under `apps/api` (`app/Support/Events`, `Capabilities`, `ExtensionManifest`, `Jobs`, and provider slot constants). Regenerate with:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate
```

Or verify CI drift:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate --check
```

## Callable transport boundary

Selection, fallback, probe, and restore-defaults stay host-owned. Versioned ProviderRegistry and Host.InvokeProvider accept only operation invoke. Legacy known-slot probe/send must override ProviderCall or use provider-specific compatibility APIs.

Callable transport exists (see wire RPCs).

## Host-known slots

| Slot | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `mail.provider` | Outbound mail transport (e.g. built-in sforum.smtp). Implies net.outbound when selected as a plugin provider. |
| `search.provider` | Full-text search engine transport. Core owns documents/ACL/jobs and the default in-process site engine (sforum.search-site, protected builtin). Optional engines (e.g. sforum.search-meilisearch) implement the same slot. |
| `attachment.storage.provider` | Object storage for attachments. Core keeps local (and existing OSS/COS/FTP/SFTP) drivers; plugins may implement the slot (E6, selection plugin:<extensionId>). See decision 2026-07-12-attachment-storage-plugin-provider. |
| `human_verification.provider` | Human verification / CAPTCHA-style checks (core Altcha default). |
| `auth.risk.provider` | Login/registration risk signals (core default). |
| `editor.sanitizer.provider` | Rich-text sanitizer policy (core default). |

## Versioned provider declaration

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `id` / `contractVersion` | Versioned provider candidate identity; `contractVersion` is `id@positiveVersion` |
| `slot` / `targetId` | Host-known slot or namespaced plugin slot contract |
| `label` | Operator-facing selection label |
| `handler` | Backend handler for `ProviderCall` |
| `requestSchema` / `responseSchema` | Required for versioned V2 slots |
| `fallback` | `next` or `closed` for versioned slots |
| `timeoutMs` | Versioned slots: 1..5000 |
| `priority` | Host candidate ordering |

## Wire RPCs

| Direction | RPC | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host → plugin | `ProviderCall` | Selected versioned provider implementation |
| Plugin → host | `ServiceDiscoveryService.InvokeProvider` | Consumer calls selected slot |

**Versioned path only accepts `operation=invoke`.** `pluginv2.VersionedProviderOperationInvoke` / Host `InvokeVersionedProvider` and `provider_slot_execution` reject every other operation. Legacy known-slot `probe`/`send` must override the generated `ProviderCall` RPC or use provider-specific compatibility APIs — they must not be faked through `pluginv2.ProviderRegistry` or `Host.InvokeProvider`.

SDK: `pluginv2.ProviderRegistry` (invoke only) for versioned providers; `Host.InvokeProvider` for consumers (rejects non-invoke).
